text: For Paul the stage entrance of that theater. <break time="0.8s" /> Was the actual portal of Romance. <break time="0.8s" /> And once he passed through it. <break time="0.8s" /> The dull world of Cordelia Street. <break time="0.8s" /> Simply ceased to exist. <break time="0.8s" /> He did not want to become an actor. <break time="0.8s" /> Any more than he wanted to become a musician. <break time="0.8s" /> For what he wanted was to be carried away from everything. <break time="0.8s" /> After a night behind the scenes. <break time="0.8s" /> Paul found the schoolroom more repulsive than ever. <break time="0.8s" /> With its bare floors and naked walls. <break time="0.8s" /> And prosy teachers. <break time="0.8s" /> Who never wore violets in their buttonholes. <break time="0.8s" /> To make up for this. <break time="0.8s" /> He told his classmates wild stories. <break time="0.8s" /> About his friendship with the actors. <break time="0.8s" /> Boasting that he would soon leave school. <break time="0.8s" /> To sail for Naples, Venice, and Egypt. <break time="0.8s" /> When his teachers complained once again. <break time="0.8s" /> The principal went to Pauls father. <break time="0.8s" /> And it was decided. <break time="0.8s" /> That the boy must be taken out of school. <break time="0.8s" /> And put to work. <break time="0.8s" /> Another usher was found. <break time="0.8s" /> To take his place at the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> The theater doorkeeper was warned. <break time="0.8s" /> Not to admit him. <break time="0.8s" /> And Charley Edwards remorsefully promised. <break time="0.8s" /> Never to see him again. <break time="0.8s" /> Paul was sent to work as an office boy. <break time="0.8s" /> For Denny and Carson. <break time="0.8s" /> And it was there, on a Friday afternoon. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was given the firms money. <break time="0.8s" /> To deposit in the bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Instead of taking it to the bank. <break time="0.8s" /> He kept the money. <break time="0.8s" /> And boarded a train for the East. <break time="0.8s" /> And the next gray dawn found him. <break time="0.8s" /> Rushing through a January snowstorm toward New York.
